Conclusion: The test `test_downsample_dst_at_midnight` checks whether the `groupby` method handles timezone transitions correctly. However, it fails due to an ambiguous time error in the `pandas.core.resample.TimeGrouper._get_time_bins` method. This method uses `date_range` which cannot infer daylight saving time (DST) transitions without repeated times. In this case, the input DatetimeIndex does not have repeated times at midnight on the day of the DST transition, causing the `AmbiguousTimeError`.

Suggested fixes:
```
pandas.core.resample.TimeGrouper._get_time_bins
```
